sentences.text:
2. Apprehending her arrest, the applicant has approached this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail, in connection with Kunda P.S. Case No.40 of 2023, registered for the offence under Sections 147, 148, 149, 498A, 494, 323, 341 & 34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Chatra.
3.
The applicant is the second wife of the informant's husband.
4. Innocence of the applicant has been claimed and undertaking has been given for co-operating with the investigating agency and participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that it is a family dispute which has been aggravated.
Since the applicant is a female and she undertakes to cooperate with the investigating agency and is also ready to participation in the trial.

On the above basis,
prayer for bail has been made.
5. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.
6. Considering the nature of allegation between the parties, I am inclined to grant the privilege of anticipatory bail to the applicant.

Accordingly, the applicant is directed to surrender in the court Sita Devi vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... ... on 11 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50146652/

Chatra, in connection with Kunda P.S. Case No.40 of 2023, subject to the condition as laid down under section438(2) Cr.P.C.

Further, the applicant will submit self-attested photocopy of her Aadhaar Card and also submit her mobile number before the learned court below which she will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.
